label: GitHub Issue
description: An issue in a repository the GitHub connector syncs: a task whose title, body, status, labels and assignees travel both ways, open while its status is anything but completed or canceled.

github_id.description: The issue's GitHub node id: set from GitHub for an issue read from it, and from GitHub's answer for a row created in Marfa and sent there. A row without one has not been sent to GitHub.

number.description: The issue's number in its repository.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

author.description: The GitHub login that opened the issue.

assignees.description: The logins the issue is assigned to.

state_reason.description: Why GitHub says the issue is closed or was reopened: completed, not_planned, duplicate or reopened, as GitHub names it.

github_updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed the issue, a new comment included.

parent_url.description: The address of the issue this one is a sub-issue of, where that issue's repository is not synced.

blocked_by_urls.description: The addresses of the issues blocking this one whose repositories are not synced.
